rules.title: Just Cause Required for Termination of Tenancy
rules.requirement: A landlord may only terminate a tenancy for specified just causes including owner or family occupancy, withdrawal from rental market, compliance with government orders, demolition or substantial remodel, with detailed notice and tenant protections.
rules.summary_plain: Your landlord can only evict you for specific reasons like moving in themselves or family, taking the property off the rental market, following government orders, or major renovations. They must give you proper written notice explaining the reason.
rules.summary_plain_es: Su arrendador solo puede desalojarlo por razones específicas como mudarse él mismo o a un familiar, sacar la propiedad del mercado de alquiler, cumplir con órdenes gubernamentales o realizar renovaciones importantes. Deben darle un aviso por escrito adecuado explicando la razón.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to residential rental properties in San Diego subject to this Division.
rules.exemptions_text: Exemptions not specified in this excerpt.
rules.quoted_span: No-fault just cause is any of the following actions taken by the landlord in good faith... (1) The owner seeks to recover possession to occupy the residential rental property for the owner or their spouse, domestic partner, child... (2) The landlord seeks to recover possession to withdraw the residential rental property from the rental market. (3) The landlord seeks to recover possession to comply with any of the following... (4) The landlord seeks to recover possession to demolish or to substantially remodel the residential rental property.

rules.title: Notice Requirements for Termination of Tenancy
rules.requirement: Landlords must provide written notice to tenants specifying the cause for termination and include tenant rights to relocation assistance when terminating tenancy for no-fault just cause.
rules.summary_plain: If your landlord ends your tenancy for no-fault reasons, they must give you written notice explaining why and inform you about your right to relocation help.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si su arrendador termina su contrato de arrendamiento por razones sin culpa, debe darle un aviso por escrito explicando por qué e informarle sobre su derecho a asistencia para la reubicación.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to residential rental properties in San Diego subject to this Division.
rules.exemptions_text: Exemptions not specified in this excerpt.
rules.quoted_span: The landlord shall give written notice to the tenant at least 30 or 60 days prior to the proposed date of termination as required by California Civil Code section 1946.1... The written notice shall contain the following: (A) The landlord shall provide a description of the basis for the termination. (B) The notice shall state the tenant’s right to relocation assistance established in section 98.0706(c) by a direct payment to the tenant or rent waiver.
